name: Monster Lover
source:
Play as Dalia the witch and romance her sweetie, Leonard the fire monster, in this cute but NSFW adventure!

[From [url=https://michelle-ehrhardt.itch.io/monster-lover]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部可爱又色气满满的成人冒险作品中，扮演女巫达莉娅，与她的甜心恋人——火焰魔物伦纳德谈一场甜蜜恋爱吧！

[摘自[url=https://michelle-ehrhardt.itch.io/monster-lover]itch.io[/url]]
